# tamper-evident-log

> Append-only audit log chained by SHA-256 or HMAC-SHA256 over a restricted canonical JSON, with ordered integrity checks and checkpoint anchoring. Python package `trysac-tamper-evident-log`, import name `tamper_evident_log`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
